title: per-prompt-ci: add quality-gating CI hook and metrics integration
description: Motivation: prevent silent regressions in prompt-set quality after model updates by integrating per-prompt eval metrics into CI and adding an automated quality gate. Changes include a new CI workflow, a gating hook that evaluates configured prompt-sets and fails PRs when thresholds are violated, and dashboards + docs for operators. Summary of changes: - add .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml to run eval harness on push/PR and publish metrics to CI artifacts - implement hooks/per_prompt_quality_gate.py that loads prompt-sets, runs evals, computes delta vs baseline, and enforces thresholds with configurable tolerances - integrate eval-metrics uploader (ci/tools/upload_eval_metrics.py) that posts to internal metrics store and exposes an artifact JSON for review - add unit and integration tests: tests/unit/test_per_prompt_gate.py, tests/integration/test_eval_ci_flow.py - update docs redwood-docs/operational/eval-gating.md with configuration and rollback guidance - add dashboard template redwood-console/dashboards/per-prompt-eval.json - small CI helpers and refactors for clearer error messages and stable seeding Checklists: - [x] add CI workflow and gating hook - [x] tests for gate logic and edge cases - [x] docs and runbook - [x] metric uploader + artifact generation - [x] manual smoke test in staging where we validated the gating against a known regression (see linear ENG-2145) Deployment plan: land behind a feature flag (eval_ci.enabled) and gradually enable for model-onboarding PRs and then broader model updates; initial thresholds conservative to avoid noise. Related work: linear ENG-2145, ENG-1987 (eval-metrics schema), SUP-412 (customer-reported regression).
